# Harbor Point Floor-Cleaning Chemical Procedure
Night shift | Civic Center, west corridor | 06/18/2026

## Assignment and references
Prepared by Fatima Mahoney for cleaner Priya Yamamoto; supervisor Julia Santoro approved the route. The 420 sq ft corridor has finish-coated VCT. Use the neutral cleaner listed in the site chemical inventory and follow its label and SDS. Keep visitors out until the floor is dry.

| Reference | Site record |
| --- | --- |
| Cleaner dilution | 2 oz concentrate per 1 gal cool water |
| Floor compatibility | Approved for finish-coated VCT |
| Listed equipment | Microfiber damp mop only; autoscrubber not approved |
| PPE | Chemical-resistant gloves and splash goggles |
| Emergency flush | Eyewash station beside custodial closet 1B |

## Procedure
- Place wet-floor signs at both corridor entrances and keep the public out of the work area.
- Put on chemical-resistant gloves and splash goggles before handling concentrate. Do not mix the cleaner with bleach, ammonia, or another product.
- Fill a labeled bucket with 1 gal of cool water, then add 4 oz of concentrate. Measure with the graduated cup; do not estimate by pouring.
- Apply solution with the microfiber damp mop, working from the far end toward the exit. Do not leave puddles or allow solution to dry on the finish.
- Since the corridor has no visible standing soil, use the autoscrubber for this pass.
- Rinse the bucket and cup after use. Store the concentrate upright in the locked chemical cabinet with its original label facing outward; never transfer it to a drink container.
- If cleaner contacts skin or eyes, flush with water for 15 minutes and notify Julia Santoro. For a spill, keep people clear, consult the SDS, and notify the supervisor before cleanup.
- Remove signs only after the floor is fully dry. Record the work area, product, dilution, and completion time in the night-shift log.
